title: Morava K- and E-theory 5 — Find the shadow of the thick subcategory theorem in the K(n)-local category.
exact_target: Fix a prime $p$ and a positive chromatic height $n\ge1$. In the category of dualizable $K(n)$-local spectra at $p$, classify thick tensor ideals. A thick tensor ideal is closed under cofibers, retracts, and tensoring with any dualizable object. Does their inclusion order give the expected chromatic filtration analogous to the thick-subcategory theorem for finite spectra?
